Full Index

The complete Watchtower database: four elemental tablets, the Tablet of Union, six Seniors per tablet, all 91 Governors of the 30 Aethyrs, the Enochian alphabet, subtablet quadrants, and 1584/1587 spelling variants.

Sources: Dee's Liber Scientiae (1584) · Tabula Recensa (1587) · Golden Dawn Enochian systematization · hermetic.com · enochian.blog · jwmt.org

Uthman Ken “Mufti Khrollo”

Reconstructing ancient wisdom for the modern seeker

Angelic Immersion is one project within a wider body of work built by Uthman Ken, known online as Mufti Khrollo — a title that already tells you where this project lives: at the crossing point of the Islamic esoteric tradition (a mufti being a scholar qualified to interpret sacred law) and a personal path of gnosis that reaches well beyond any single lineage. Writing and creating under the banner "The Gnostic Muslim," Mufti Khrollo's work moves fluently between Sufi metaphysics, Hermeticism, Qabalah, and the Enochian system of John Dee and Edward Kelley — treating these not as museum pieces, but as living technologies of consciousness that still function today.

The throughline across all of it is reconstruction: taking scattered, half-corrupted, or academically fossilized esoteric systems and rebuilding them into something a modern practitioner can actually use — annotated, cross-referenced, interactive, and stripped of the gatekeeping that so much occult scholarship hides behind. This Watchtower Database, with its clickable letters, scrying interface, and full angelic hierarchy, is a direct expression of that mission: ancient magic, rebuilt as modern software.

If this project resonated with you, the best way to go deeper is to follow the wider body of work below — long-form writing on Substack, video breakdowns on YouTube, daily fragments on Instagram and TikTok, and even a playable piece of Enochian practice on itch.io.
